data.title: Naya Gaon Holiday Homes & Resort
data.description:
Naya Gaon Holiday Homes & Resort

Thoughtfully Planned Lifestyle Community in Panchkhal, Kavre, Naya Gaon Holiday Homes & Resort is a carefully designed land development project that redefines the idea of ownership by blending security, lifestyle, and long-term value. Located in the serene and fast-growing region of Paanchkhal, Kavre, the project is envisioned not merely as a residential layout, but as a future-ready lifestyle destination.

 

Secure & Well-Planned Community

  • The project comprises a total of 145 premium plots, designed with a strong focus on safety, infrastructure, and community living. To ensure a secure and comfortable environment, Naya Gaon is equipped with:
    30ft Wide Road with Cycle Lane
  • Reliable electricity supply
  • Dedicated water treatment plant
  • Sealed boundary across the project
  • 24/7 surveillance and security system

These essential foundations create a safe, organized, and peaceful living experience for residents and investors alike.
 

More Than a Residential Project — A Lifestyle Destination

What truly sets Naya Gaon apart is its lifestyle-driven planning. The project integrates modern amenities that elevate everyday living and leisure:

  • Café and Restaurant
  • Mini Mart
  • Lush Green Open Spaces
  • Swimming Pool and Recreational Zones

These features transform Naya Gaon into a destination where comfort, relaxation, and community coexist—making it ideal for holiday homes, resort-style living, or long-term investment.

 

Plots Designed for Every Vision and Profession

Recognizing that every investor has unique aspirations, Naya Gaon offers profession-specific plot categories, thoughtfully curated to match different lifestyles and goals. The project caters to a diverse group of buyers, including digital professionals, business leaders, bankers, athletes, celebrities, families, and Non-Resident Nepalis (NRNs).

Plot Categories at Naya Gaon:

Fire Opal – For Digital Professionals

Ruby – For Celebrities

Sapphire – For Bankers

Gold – For Working Professionals

Tanzanite – For Sports Personalities

Emerald – For Business Owners

Topaz – For Non-Resident Nepalis (NRNs)

Diamond – For Families and Friends

Rose Quartz – For Commercial Purposes

 

Each category reflects a distinct vision of living and investment, allowing buyers to choose a plot that truly aligns with their future plans.

 

Flexible Plot Sizes & Competitive Pricing

Naya Gaon offers plots ranging from 6 Aana to 1 Ropani, providing flexibility for both personal and commercial use. The project includes all 145 plots within this range, ensuring a variety of choices for different investment capacities.

 

Price per Aana:

Starting from NPR 700,000

Up to NPR 975,000, depending on plot category and location

This transparent and tiered pricing structure makes Naya Gaon a strong proposition for buyers seeking high ROI potential in a growing destination.

 

A Smart Investment for Today, A Secure Future for Tomorrow

Naya Gaon Holiday Homes & Resort is designed for individuals who think long-term—those who value planned growth, lifestyle quality, and investment security. Whether you are an NRN looking to stay connected to your roots, a professional planning for the future, or a family seeking a peaceful community, Naya Gaon offers a place where your vision can take shape.

 

Naya Gaon is not just land.

It is a destination built for the future.

data.title: Chalnakhel Smart Land Development Project
data.description:
In Nepal, Vastu Shastra is more than just an old tradition—it’s something people truly believe in. It’s about building your home in a way that brings peace, good energy, and balance into your life. That’s why Chalnakhel feels just right. The land naturally opens to the east, the slope is just as Vastu suggests, and the area is calm and full of positive vibes. You’re close to places like Dakshinkali Mandir, Sikali Mandir, and the peaceful Taudaha Lake. Plus, with the Dry Port, this area isn’t just spiritually strong—it’s growing with new possibilities. If you’ve been looking for the right place to build your future, Chalnakhel quietly checks every box.

 

Positioned perfectly between nature, tradition, and connectivity, Chalnakhel is emerging as one of the most promising land investment destinations near Kathmandu. Just 1 km from Taudaha Lake, 3 km from Chobhar Dry Port, and only 7 km from Balkhu, Chalnakhel offers unmatched access to both serenity and infrastructure. It is also just 6 km from Tribhuvan University and 5km from Mediciti Hospital, placing it within a golden circle of the education sector and medical care. It is ideal for affluent Nepali families, returnee investors, and anyone seeking to blend peaceful living with strong land value appreciation.
